plainLanguage: Tearing the chest muscle's tendon is a recognised injury that has been reported to happen while bench pressing.
qualifiers: Case reports and pooled case series have no denominator, so nothing here supports a rate, a risk, or a comparison between exercises.
This is context, not medical, diagnostic or rehabilitation advice; the project does not give any.
The commonly repeated association with anabolic steroid use is described in the literature as lacking coherent supporting evidence.

conditions: bench pressing, reported in individual cases and in pooled case series

statement: Rupture of the pectoralis major tendon is reported to occur during the bench press, and published case reports describe it happening during a bench press manoeuvre.
